description: This is a PHP class file for a Drupal migration source plugin that extracts file data from a Drupal 6 database. It defines a class 'File' extending DrupalSqlBase, with methods for querying files, initializing file paths, preparing data rows, and defining fields and IDs. The class handles configuration for site path, file paths, and public/private file storage.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A Drupal 6 file source plugin class for migrating file data from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to select files, excluding temporary files, ordered by timestamp and file ID.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes file path variables based on configuration and site path, determines if files are public or private.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Sets source properties for file paths and privacy status on each data row.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the fields available in the data source, such as fid, uid, filename, filepath, filemime, status, timestamp, file_directory_path, is_public.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'fid'.
